skills.delivery_notes: channel-move spin dealing weapon hits in a radius while walking freely through packs; whirlwind is the purpose-built '360-degree spin = radial melee AoE' type — a lossless fit. physical -> no element family; full-movement-during-channel is native to whirlwind. leech sustains from physical hits

mapping_json.motion_frame: spin-to-win channel bruiser: hold and steer into packs, hit everything in the spin radius continuously while moving, overleech keeps you topped; the genre's modern spin reference
mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Cleanest map alongside cleave. whirlwind IS Cyclone — the engine type is literally the spin-to-win archetype, and channel-move + radius-weapon-hits + full-movement-during-channel are all native to it. physical -> no element family (crosswalk §1). leech-sustain is a standard regen/sustain shape (Slayer overleech = leech-continues-at-full-life, a regen flavor). persistent_condition_shape=tick-cost carries the channel cost. NOTHING identity-bearing is lost for the CORE Cyclone. The Fire (Ngamahu) and CoC (Cospri) variants are SEPARATE kits/roles — Ngamahu = ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL fire-conversion flavor; CoC-host = the coc-ice-nova kit's chassis — noted as variants, NOT folded into the core physical-Cyclone identity (which is the reference here). ZONE_CONTROL / MOMENTUM_CASCADE for the spin-through-packs momentum capstone.
